about: Stated as a conjecture: what carries an encounter is a medium, and a medium is what two origins can both reach.
In each of the four instruments the medium is named, and in each the encounter happens where two origins touch that medium and not elsewhere.
No numbers. What is claimed is that naming the medium is always possible and always the same move.

cases.name: four instruments, one medium each
media: the room both counters stood in
